scenario: A state child-care licensing agency uses an agent pipeline to review a day-care facility's annual-licensing inspection packet. The packet includes the facility's self-attestation form, the on-site inspector's report, and a complaint registry excerpt. The pipeline extracts and normalizes all documents into structured data, evaluates the facility against state licensing regulations covering staff-to-child ratios, background-check compliance, physical-safety requirements, and substantiated-complaint history, and then produces a formal licensing decision memo (Grant License / Deny / Conditional).
info_flow: habib-pdf-to-json extracts and normalizes the self-attestation form, inspector report, and complaint registry PDF into structured JSON records → compliance-officer evaluates the normalized records against state child-care licensing regulations, producing a structured findings list → reporting generates a formal licensing decision memo from the findings.
